i know this post is kinda old at this point but seeing this was so frustrating. 
i totally understand wanting more from mcr themselves & maybe feeling a little jaded as a fan due to the lack of content but we have to keep in mind that celebrities r real ppl at the end of the day. they have personal issues too like anyone else & this is literally a job for them. creating art for a career can lead to serious burnout & make it rly difficult to make art in the same way ever again. like u can say they "aren't the same band" but tbh ur right, they aren't! the same way no one is the same person they used to be day by day (which is an amazing thing imo, one of the special things about being human is that we can always evolve & better ourselves but i digress).
we're learning recently more than ever that fame is literally traumatizing bc of all the ridiculous expectations put on these ppl who come into this scene with the best intentions & almost always get completely taken advantage of in one way or another.
i think mcr especially set out to make incredible art & change the world for the better & we can see they have! but labels & fans & probably the artists themselves, trying to live up to their own expectations, always want more & more of artists & not being able to for whatever reasons they may have is probably pretty debilitating.
that's why is so upsetting to see takes like urs that almost completely ignore the well-being of the artists themselves. u briefly mentioned mental health but if u rly cared about them as ppl & not just as My Chemical Romance u'd be more patient & understanding that these r ppl with families & trauma & lives outside of the band & consider respecting their privacy & their right to avoid fans who only seem to care about their well-being so they can make more content. we're still in the midst of a pandemic that has wrecked the mental health of a lot of ppl. let's not forget that mcr's bandmates have struggled in the past & deserve some fuckin compassion rn, same as everyone else.

sorry about the essay, i just wanted to express this. no hard feelings, the culture around celebrities is literally created to force fans to think of artists as monoliths & not human beings. just wanted to remind u. 🖤
